steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You have nowhere left to run.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...Damn... you!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Where do you think you're going?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Put your hands where I can see them!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've seen through all your tricks, kid with the scales!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I told you, that's not going to work!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hmph, don't worry. These attacks hurt about as much as firecrackers!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You blocked my shots in advance.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You know where they're coming from?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course I do, I've already figured you out.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya, back off. I'm going to use 'that'!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Got it! I'll disrupt Mephisto's guards again, so make it quick!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Take this bit of my blood as a farewell gift, Reunion's 'Phantom Crossbowmen!'

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Seethe, and blast apart their disguise!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You're using your own blood as an incendiary?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah, do I look like some sort of caster to you? Only some egotistical newbie would go around committing arson like that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry, but this is just one of my fighting techniques. Show yourselves - you have nowhere to hide!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Faust, my camouflage is gone.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Command, retreat.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: What are those...?! When did Reunion hide snipers over there?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Now?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Right now.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Multiple Reunion snipers have appeared, primarily in the 2nd floor of the east building and the 3rd floor of the south building!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Proceed with caution. They might have set up ambushes for us on the lower levels!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Was the strange phenomenon in the building also caused by them?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Clever, you used refraction to make themselves seem invisible.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: However, you can't completely conceal your tracks, or make sudden movements without compromising the effect of your Arts.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Am I correct?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...You're quite smart.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's all because of our great intel. Now that you know the gig's up, you should surrender.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If you want to continue fighting, I'll make you pay for the deaths of Ace and Scout. Hmph, I don't even care if you weren't involved, kid.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Faust, we still have ammunition.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Retreat. We've already lost our intel advantage. I will keep them occupied. The rest of you, move immediately.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Why aren't you shooting her? Faust!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Attack, my guards! Hurry! There are four of them, just four... and only three of them pose any threat!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Fight! Tear apart those sinners now!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: With Dr. {@nickname}'s leadership, the three of us are more than enough to defeat all of you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not to mention, those Infected who you harmed, who you robbed of their free will to the point of not even being people anymore...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even that scaled boy next to you might not side with you anymore. His thoughts are filled with sorrow and turmoil...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mephisto, you are alone on this battlefield!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You can read my mind?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, I just felt it.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: So, you'd have no idea what I'm thinking.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm fine, I can barely block his shots...! However, I won't be able to keep suppressing...

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: GRAAAAAAGHHH!! AAAARRRRGGHH!!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My control is slipping!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto, let's go.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Their reinforcements are wiping out our forces.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: We've never even seen some of them before. There's been a change in the plan. Our moves have been read.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...Why haven't our forces come? We have over twenty squads and two major brigades, so why are none of them here still?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Where is Crownslayer? Or FrostNova?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: This isn't like Chernobog. We couldn't shut down the enemy's communications, so they were able to call lots of reinforcements and put up a vigorous resistance.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Where are they still not here yet?!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: We won't know the reason unless we see it for ourselves. Let's get out of here first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze, I'm about to reach my limit. Can you finish this?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sure thing. Just me and that Ch'en lady should suffice!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Quick!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did I give you permission to leave?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You... Guards! Kill her! Kill her!!

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: Grrr... Grooooar!!!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Tsk... Over a dozen of them started moving at once. That's going to be a pain.

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: GROOAAAAAR!!!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: They're coming at us, Ch'en!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thank you, Rhodes Island operator. Now, nobody can get in my way.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Haah... it's still no good? I don't have a way to completely counteract their cloaking... Forget it, this should be good enough.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Chi Xiao, this time...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 'Crimson overflowing—'

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: ...Gah!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Can it be...?

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: Uaaagh... Argh...

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: Thank... you...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did you unsheath your sword just then? Just one slash? And you managed to cut down a dozen of those things?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That sword...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya, I think I should start choosing my words a lot more carefully around her.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You... What did you do...

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You can't escape either.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Gah...!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust... Faust! You're injured! You're... no, no... Nooo!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's over.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... He lured me in to shoot from point blank?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Didn't you manage to block it though?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They used the cover of the explosion to make their escape!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Woah, a chain of explosions?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Argh, the entire top level is collapsing! We're not going to be able to chase after them?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Half of that was your doing.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Can't do a thing about that.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Hurry, we need to go.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: No, I need to stay here, until they come...

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: We've failed this step. You must leave.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I failed? I failed? Impossible!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Wasn't everything going according to plan...? Did I not call for our reinforcements a long time ago?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Were we betrayed? Was our information leaked? Who was it? Why does the L.G.D. know about our deployment and our strategies?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Just go!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If we weren't betrayed, then who could have done it?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Talulah would never make a mistake... So she must have planned for this...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: No, that's impossible... Why would she set us up like this?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...Faust, there's no way I can accept this... I refuse to believe it.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Jump! I'll hold on to you!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Fine...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well... shoot, Madam. Looks like this building's going to need some serious renovating.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's a shame that those two kids got away though.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Those mindless followers are still coming at us like cornered animals. Dealing with all of them is still going to be a serious thorn in the side.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At least we managed to take back the headquarters.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is our victory, even if it's a short-lived one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How did Rhodes Island manage to make it out of Chernobog?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Blaze came to our aid in the knick of time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There was also a loud-mouthed L.G.D. officer just outside the ruined city...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It would've been easier if you had just helped us in the first place instead of watching from the sidelines.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I was expecting you to say something like 'I didn't need Rhodes Island's help anyway,' or 'I'd rather die than work with them.'

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But at least you don't seem to be that stubborn. Is there anything else you'd like to say? If not, I'd like to head back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I never knew Rhodes Island had an aircraft like that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Heh, we have a lot of things that might surprise you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just like you, we don't want to play our entire hand.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're not counting us as one of your cards, are you?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Um, Madam Ch'en... there's an incoming transmission on a private line.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: It's for you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Well done, Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Is Madam Swire also on this channel?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Please report your progress.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I bailed Rhodes Island out, and also finished arrangements for the various brigades. Coordinating and managing everything took me three full nights.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How about you, Madam Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've already taken back—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: —with Rhodes Island's assistance, we've taken back the L.G.D. Headquarters. Their commander will spread word of their defeat through the ranks.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The Reunion forces left in Lungmen have been coralled into our ambush points using the routes we arranged for them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Next, we just need to wait for their counterattack.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: My mission is now complete.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I've also received reports from a few of your other colleagues. All missions in the last phase have been completed flawlessly. Well done, all of you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We will now move onto the next phase.
